personas.label: Fixture account; permission projection varies by Workspace

routes.label: Owner Home
routes.goal: Identify review work, blocked or assigned active tickets, and recent updates; open an actual record.
routes.dataState: Mixed review states, in-progress/queued tickets with a coder and dependency blocker, done/closed tickets and an Objective.

routes.label: Non-owner Home
routes.goal: Read the same work records without owner-only management controls.
routes.dataState: All management permissions false; same authorized read-only work projections as owner.

routes.label: Long names and selectors
routes.goal: Read long record titles and branch selectors without page-wide overflow.
routes.dataState: Owner with long Workspace name, Objective title, and Merge Request selectors.

routes.label: Empty Workspace
routes.goal: Distinguish empty work scopes without fabricated status totals.
routes.dataState: All dashboard resource queries successfully return empty collections.

routes.label: Reviews unavailable
routes.goal: Keep active work and recent updates usable when reviews fail; never claim all-clear.
routes.dataState: Intentional HTTP 503 from Merge Requests. Expected visible error and browser HTTP console diagnostic; other resource requests succeed.
